notes:
User is planning a structured weekly routine. They now exercise four times per week (previously identified Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday; the fourth day is unspecified) and plans to reward themselves with a post-workout smoothie on Saturday. Social commitments include dinner with Rachel on Friday and family dinner next Saturday. They want time for reading, meditation, meals, and admin tasks. Current task batching: Friday is admin day; Sunday is meal prep day. They may also dedicate other days to gym, chores, meditation, and reading. A prior suggested schedule had included Monday admin, Wednesday meal prep, and a lighter Friday due to Rachel, but the user’s latest routine supersedes that.

They plan to make Quinoa and Roasted Vegetable Bowls on Sunday, customized with grilled chicken and black beans for extra protein. They also previously selected Grilled Chicken and Veggie Containers as a convenient meal-prep option, pairing chicken, varied roasted vegetables, and quinoa or brown rice. Container quantity and preferred container size/brand remain unanswered.

For cooking/food safety: chicken may be marinated 30–60 minutes or overnight and cooked to 165°F/74°C; vegetables can roast at 425°F/220°C for roughly 20–25 minutes.

User reads mystery/thrillers and finished their previous book on Saturday. They are interested in *The Silent Patient* by Alex Michaelides and plan to add it to their reading list.

For organization, they use a habit tracker app to manage daily and weekly tasks plus meditation and exercise routines, and it has helped them stay consistent and on track. They also use designated days for recurring tasks to reduce decision fatigue and improve efficiency. Productivity suggestions previously included setting three SMART weekly goals, listing tasks, assigning high/medium/low priorities, using a calendar, avoiding multitasking, scheduling breaks and self-care, and reviewing/adjusting the week.
